pairs.fix: Show the ice cream sign at an angle and larger, with the cone close to the bottom edge and the scoop near the top corner.

pattern: The generated cards show the whole object, small to mid-size, centered and often straight on, with equal empty space on every side. Their margins often sit above the real maximum (about 0.10), or the box is too short or too small. Real cards push the hero bigger, turn it three-quarters, and let it touch or get cut off by an edge.
